FEAT-3-S55.title: Clinical Trials Search Input/Output Schema Validation
FEAT-3-S55.description: Define and enforce Pydantic schemas for clinical trial search inputs (condition, location, radius) and outputs (trial metadata, recruiting status, distance, duration) ensuring strict contract validation before and after service execution.

FEAT-3-S56.title: EvaluateCare Facade Integration for Clinical Trials Search
FEAT-3-S56.description: Integrate clinical trials search capability into evaluate_care_facade to orchestrate schema validation, service invocation, and response formatting for tool_router consumption.

FEAT-3-S57.title: Clinical Trials Service Unit and Integration Tests
FEAT-3-S57.description: Create unit tests for clinical_trials_service covering API query construction, recruiting filter enforcement, distance calculations, and error handling, plus integration tests through the facade to validate end-to-end behavior.
